name: classification_threshold
note: Minimum confidence (0-1) to accept a gender: a genderdata first-name prediction (max(proportion_male, 1 - proportion_male)) or a Wikidata person match (scores below). Below it a statue stays Unknown. Set to 1 to accept only certain answers.

name: wikidata_exact_confidence
note: Wikidata human whose label or matched alias equals the subject X (ignoring titles and punctuation)

name: wikidata_partial_confidence
note: Wikidata human whose label contains X, or X contains the label

name: wikidata_weak_confidence
note: Wikidata human found by the search, but the names differ
